summary: Frontend-only test of the new full-screen waiting screen for pending rides (RideTrackingPage). RESULT: 6/7 acceptance criteria PASS, 1 critical visual bug FAIL. All required data-testids are present and the entire waiting UX (title 'Recherche d'un chauffeur...', subtitle 'Nous contactons les chauffeurs proches', SearchingRadar size 220, ride-searching-route card with Tour Eiffel→Gare du Nord/11.27€, three action buttons) renders correctly. The old stepper + 'Veuillez patienter' card are GONE. Buttons all work: Relancer fires toast 'Recherche relancée' and shows 'Relance 1/3…'; Annuler opens the CancelRideModal with reasons list; Pool toggle button is present. /course→Demander correctly navigates to /ride/:id. CRITICAL VISUAL BUG: the page renders on WHITE background instead of the spec-required navy #0B1426 because the global rule .mobile-container { background: #ffffff } in /app/frontend/src/index.css L173 overrides the Tailwind arbitrary class bg-[#0B1426] (same CSS specificity, .mobile-container is loaded after Tailwind utilities). The visual V3Cube dark-blue full-screen radar experience is therefore NOT actually shown to the user — radar appears floating on white, white title text is invisible on white background.

ui_bugs.issue: Background renders WHITE instead of navy #0B1426. Tailwind arbitrary utility bg-[#0B1426] is overridden by .mobile-container { background: #ffffff } in /app/frontend/src/index.css (L168-174). Same specificity, but index.css is loaded after the Tailwind layer so the white wins. Result: the full-screen 'dark-blue radar' V3Cube look is not delivered to users — title 'Recherche d'un chauffeur...' (text-white) becomes invisible on white background, and the visual identity required by the spec is missing.

issues: White-on-white text: title 'Recherche d'un chauffeur...' and subtitle are invisible due to white BG override (see ui_bugs above). Action buttons ('Activer Taxi Pool', 'Relancer la recherche', 'Annuler la course') still readable because they use colored/red text, but the overall waiting screen looks broken compared to the V3Cube reference.

action_items: FIX the white-background override on the pending RideTrackingPage. Options (pick one, simplest first): (a) replace the className 'bg-[#0B1426]' with an inline style={{ backgroundColor: '#0B1426' }} on the pending-state root div (L463 of /app/frontend/src/pages/user/RideTrackingPage.js) so it beats .mobile-container, (b) use Tailwind important modifier '!bg-[#0B1426]', (c) remove the global `background: #ffffff` from `.mobile-container` in /app/frontend/src/index.css L173 and let each page set its own bg (risk: affects other mobile pages relying on default white). Recommended: option (a) — fully scoped, no side-effects.
critical_code_review_comments: CSS architecture: .mobile-container hard-codes background: #ffffff in index.css L173. This silently wins against Tailwind utility classes (same specificity, later in cascade) — any page trying to set a custom bg via Tailwind on the mobile-container will fail. Consider removing the background from .mobile-container, or move it into a separate utility like .mobile-container-white that is opt-in, to prevent future regressions of the same kind.

RideTrackingPage.js is 887 lines and has TWO parallel rendering branches for pending state (the new full-screen early-return L461-565 AND the legacy block at L623+ which still references toggle-taxi-pool-btn/cancel-ride-btn). The legacy pending block at L623+ is now unreachable (early-return at L461 always wins) but its testids ARE DUPLICATED in the JSX source — this will not affect runtime queryselector results (DOM only contains the early-return tree) but it makes static analysis/grep noisy and confuses future maintainers. Recommend deleting the now-dead pending branch from the bottom block.

success_rate.frontend: 86% (6/7 acceptance criteria; only the navy background visual fails)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The new full-screen pending UX is FUNCTIONALLY correct (all testids, copy, buttons, modals work). The single remaining issue is purely CSS: white background visible instead of #0B1426 due to .mobile-container { background:#ffffff } override. To re-test after fix: login rider.qa@demo.sb/Rider123!, create new ride via /course?mode=standard, then on /ride/:id assert that getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid="ride-tracking-page"]')).backgroundColor === 'rgb(11, 20, 38)'. Note: a ride created in production stays 'pending' only briefly (~1-2 min) before auto-dispatch cancels it — chain tests fast or create a fresh ride per assertion. Mobile-viewport login requires clicking 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' then 'email & mot de passe' before email/password inputs appear.
rca of the issue: Root cause: CSS specificity tie + cascade order. Both .mobile-container and the Tailwind-generated .bg-\[\#0B1426\] have specificity (0,1,0). When two rules tie, the later one in the stylesheet wins. Tailwind utility CSS is injected at the @tailwind utilities layer which is loaded before the custom CSS in index.css, so .mobile-container { background: #ffffff } (defined at /app/frontend/src/index.css L173) overrides the Tailwind utility. Repro: open /ride/<pending_id>, run getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid="ride-tracking-page"]')).backgroundColor → returns 'rgb(255, 255, 255)' even though className contains 'bg-[#0B1426]'. Mitigation: inline style={{backgroundColor:'#0B1426'}} (specificity 1,0,0,0 — always wins), OR use Tailwind important modifier '!bg-[#0B1426]', OR remove the background declaration from .mobile-container.
